findings.fix_plan: Edit only ~/.claude/hooks/session-autopush.js. (1) At the top: const DEADLINE = Date.now() + 55000. In git(), use timeout: Math.max(1, Math.min(timeoutSec, Math.floor((DEADLINE - Date.now())/1000) - 2)) * 1000. (2) Before the rebase and before the push: if DEADLINE - Date.now() < 35000 (rebase) or < 10000 (push), call fail(`${label}: committed locally, not pushed, out of time; push by hand.`). (3) Lock: right after gitDir is known (step 4), try fs.openSync(path.join(gitDir,'autopush.lock'),'wx') and write `${process.pid} ${Date.now()}`. On EEXIST, read the file; if the timestamp is older than 120 s, replace the lock, otherwise quit() quietly. Release it with process.on('exit', () => { try { fs.unlinkSync(lockPath) } catch(_){} }), registered only once the lock is held; fail() and quit() call process.exit, so a finally block would not run. (4) In git(), record r.signal. After the fetch, if it failed with r.signal set or err matches /signal \d+/, call quit() instead of fail() (it was killed, not offline). (5) Fix the header comment to say the 55 s deadline and the lock.
